tagline: Track the day. Build the life.
theme: Light Theme (Calm, Minimal, Slate Accent, High Legibility)

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
scale.subtitle: text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-500 font-normal leading-relaxed
scale.metric_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 tracking-tight

desktop_sidebar.style: Fixed left navigation bar with brand header, quick daily status indicator, nav items with active accent indicator, and bottom user profile/settings summary.

mobile_nav.style: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (`block md:hidden z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200`) with icon tabs + floating quick '+ Add Entry' action button.

main_container.padding: px-4 sm:px-8 py-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-8

grid_modes.bento_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 sm:gap-6

dashboard.header: Personalized Greeting ('Good morning / evening, [User]'), live date badge, Today's Completion Progress Bar + Circular Ring.
dashboard.quick_action: Prominent '+ Log Today's Entry' button in slate blue (#2563EB) opening the 3-minute quick logger.
widgets: Today's Habits Check-grid (Reading, Writing, Workout, Learning, Journal, Substack)
Weekly Progress Bars & Streak Counters (Current streak vs Best streak)

daily_entry.ux_goal: Complete total daily record in 3-5 minutes at night.
daily_entry.layout: Accordion or clean tabbed multi-step form with progress feedback.
sections: Reading (Book title, pages read, key takeaway)
Writing (Page/Word count target reached check, topic)
Exercise/Workout (Type, duration min, calories burned, body weight kg/lbs)
Morning Journal & Night Journal (Autosaving text fields)

daily_review.concept: Daily snapshot archive view with clean card layout, completion badges, and word/page counter summaries.

reading_tracker.grid: Grid of current reading books (with progress bars %) + completed bookshelf grid + 'Add Book' dialog.
reading_tracker.features: Status filter tags (Reading, Completed, Want to Read), star ratings, short book review cards.

writing_workspace.stats: Daily goal tracker, writing streaks count, monthly total words.
writing_workspace.editor: Distraction-free clean rich markdown editor with daily target word counter & auto-save status.

exercise_and_health.charts: Recharts interactive line & bar graphs for Weight over time, Calories burned, and Workout Duration.

learning_timeline.visual: Vertical timeline of learning milestones with date pills, topic tags, and lesson notes.

journal.structure: Split view: Morning Journal (Intentions, Gratitude) and Night Journal (Reflection, Wins).
journal.history: Searchable previous journal logs by tag and date range.

monitoring.concept: Custom metrics tracker (e.g., Water intake, Screen time, Sleep hrs, Caffeine).
monitoring.widgets: Custom metric setup cards + historical trend charts.

substack_workspace.kanban_board: 4 Column Drag & Drop Pipeline: IDEA → DRAFTING → REVISION → PUBLISHED.
substack_workspace.editor: Embedded drawer/modal for writing full Substack articles with target word counts and publication check.

history.calendar: Monthly GitHub-style activity heat-map matrix showing habit completion states per day.

settings.configurations: Habit target goals configuration, metric units (kg/lbs, km/miles), and JSON/CSV data export.

component_styling_rules.cards: Use bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 sm:p-6 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all shadow-sm shadow-slate-100

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors shadow-sm text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors text-sm
buttons.outline: border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors text-sm

component_styling_rules.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all
component_styling_rules.modals_and_drawers: Must use bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xl (NEVER fully transparent without blur)
component_styling_rules.toasts: Use Sonner library with custom slate light styling.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, submit buttons, nav links, status tags, habit checkboxes, inputs, and key metric displays MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='quick-add-entry-btn', data-testid='nav-reading-tracker').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All text elements maintain WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 contrast against light background (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF).
testing_and_accessibility.code_format: React code files must use standard .js / .jsx file extensions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts link for Outfit, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono in index.html.
Implement the full application with high fidelity, mock data for historical analytics, local storage persistence, and seamless modal dialogs.
Ensure the night entry form is streamlined for 3-5 minute completion.
Use Recharts for clean, responsive line & bar visualizations in Exercise and Custom Monitoring pages.
Always apply data-testid on all key interactive elements.
